name: Aurora Origin
source:
Aurora: Origin is the first part of the game series set in the universe of the same-name game Aurora: Urban Secrets.

This time you’re going to take a new exciting journey where you will meet new characters, complete the general plot of the Aurora universe and for sure entertain yourself with some hot erotic scenes.

You've got brand new adventures ahead!​
translation:
《Aurora: Origin》是同名游戏宇宙系列的第一部作品，故事设定在《Aurora: Urban Secrets》的世界中。

这一次，你将踏上一段全新的精彩旅程，结识新角色，了解《Aurora》宇宙的主线故事，当然也能欣赏火辣的情色场景。

全新的冒险正在前方等着你！
